_about: Pictures for the Haven's regions (TerritorySettings.RegionInfo, keyed by the region's name in lower case with spaces as _), for Tools/LocalSpawn/generate_item_icons.py --set regions, painted whole in the skill icons' dark style (UX pass 2026-11-28: the Lands tab showed each region as its first letter). One clear landscape vignette each, Nordic forest under a curse, readable small.
ravenwood: Old dark pines beside a still tarn, ravens perched on a dead branch watching a forest road, grey dusk light
eastwood: Open birch and pine woods with a trapper's path leading to an old stone quarry cut into a hillside, soft morning light
the_hollow_pines: Tall dead-straight bare pine trunks in rows with nothing growing beneath, pale mist, eerie silence, cold light
the_wolfwood: A dark tangled forest with a wolf den under roots and glowing eyes in the shadows, an old barrow mound, red moonlight
westwood: Quiet cedar woods on a ridge with an old wooden watchtower and a small mere below, warm evening light
the_grey_pines: A strip of thin pines under tall grey cliffs, fallen boulders and old tree stumps, overcast light
greyfell: A bare rocky mountain with stone benches climbing to a windswept peak, ore veins glinting in the cliffs, cold wind
the_drowning_fen: A black bog with dark pools between hummocks, a wooden causeway leading to standing stones half sunk in water, green mist
stillwater: A great calm lake with standing stones on a small island and a wooden landing on the shore, silver light
hightarn: A cold black tarn in bare northern hills, very still water reflecting the sky, an old fishing rock, pale light
alder_mere: A reedy mere ringed with alder trees, still water and lily pads, soft hushed green light
